claims.text: Conformal prediction is a model-agnostic framework.
Conformal prediction is a distribution-free framework.
Conformal prediction combines flexibility with strong statistical guarantees.
Conformal prediction provides uncertainty quantification to mitigate risks such as hallucinations in NLP systems.

evidence.description: The authors state that conformal prediction has a model-agnostic and distribution-free nature.
The paper identifies conformal prediction as being distribution-free.
The authors describe conformal prediction as combining flexibility with strong statistical guarantees.
Uncertainty quantification via conformal prediction is highlighted as a mechanism to mitigate risks like hallucinations and enhance reliability.

methodologies.name: Literature Survey of Conformal Prediction in NLP
methodologies.description: A comprehensive survey reviewing conformal prediction techniques, statistical guarantees, and existing NLP applications.

limitations.text: Current NLP systems suffer from shortcomings due to the absence of uncertainty quantification, creating risks like hallucinations.

future_work.text: Addressing open challenges and future research directions for conformal prediction techniques in NLP.
